name: kirsch
description: Task runner for Kirsch. The project is Go; npm is here only as a familiar front door to the commands that matter.

scripts.check: npm run fmt:check && npm run vet && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run screens
scripts.test:cover: go test -coverprofile=coverage.out ./... && go tool cover -func=coverage.out | tail -1
scripts.security: npm run security:vuln && npm run security:sast && npm run security:secrets
scripts.ci: npm run check && npm run security && npm run test:race
